title: CFA lane 3: corporate issuers (capital budgeting and cost of capital)
mission: Curate atomic, reusable corporate-finance relationships: NPV/IRR/payback/profitability-index arithmetic, cost of capital (CAPM-use, WACC, flotation), leverage and working-capital arithmetic, each with explicit timing, compounding and tax-scope conventions. Closed forms only; continue through successive batches with no project-evaluation chain required.
priorities: Net present value as a discounted sum with explicit timing and discount-rate meaning
Payback and discounted-payback period arithmetic with stated conventions
Profitability index from present value and investment with stated timing
Weighted average cost of capital from component costs and weights with stated tax scope
Cost of equity via CAPM as a formula record (owned here; portfolio lane references it, never duplicates it)
Leverage identities: degree of operating, financial and total leverage with stated bases
Working-capital arithmetic: net working capital, receivables/inventory management identities
Break-even quantity and operating break-even with stated cost behavior
boundaries: This lane owns capital-budgeting and cost-of-capital arithmetic; statement ratios, equity/fixed-income valuation, derivatives and portfolio records belong to lanes 1-2 and 4-6.
Do not resubmit the 14 covered TVM-family IDs as new coverage; record overlaps instead (see curator brief).
IRR is definitional (the rate equating NPV to zero) plus closed-form special cases only; iterative IRR solving is out of engine reach and must be deferred with sources, never approximated.
CAPM as a cost-of-equity formula lives here; portfolio-theory CAPM records live in lane 6 by reference, not duplication.
Exclude project recommendations, capital-structure advice and tax planning; records are formulas with scope.
starter_sources: Owner excerpt packet for this lane (discovery leads with exact PDF locators; corroborate every record against a directly inspected accessible source).
A public corporate-finance text with the same formulas (for example OpenStax Principles of Finance); record exact book, edition and section, never cite a root URL as evidence.
special_checks: Timing (beginning vs end of period) and compounding frequency are stated in every record and reflected in guards.
Independently sum individual discounted cash flows for NPV references instead of repeating the closed form.
Rate-approaching-zero and zero-investment boundaries are explicit branches or rejection cases, never silent substitutions.
Nominal/real, levered/unlevered and pre/post-tax quantities never mix in one expression.
integration_expectation: New meanings (net_present_value, payback_period, wacc, cost_of_equity and similar) require extension; NPV sums fit the engine via sum over index families once meanings exist. Note a heating-demo net-present-value model already exists in the runtime catalog: check the supplied inventory and record the overlap honestly instead of minting a silent duplicate. Never relabel project cash flows as operating costs to force execution.
coverage_guidance: Priorities are seeds, not a finite checklist. Continue into adjacent corporate-finance readings inside the boundaries, selecting independently reusable relationships. Save multiple bounded batches without waiting for owner review. Check supplied inventory and prior returns for equivalent relationships and conflicting IDs. Record out-of-format discoveries as deferred with exact sources and missing capabilities; do not force chains or dilute quality for a quota.
